key_exclusions: award / Rapid Rewards bookings excluded from cash-fare refund
fare difference refunded as Rapid Rewards points (formerly travel funds), not cash
policy_text_full: Southwest allows rebooking at a lower fare at any time before departure, with the fare difference refunded as Rapid Rewards points (formerly travel funds). No fee, no formal claim — handled entirely via self-service rebooking. The easiest rebook policy in the industry.
policy_text_relevant_clause: Customers can rebook at any lower advertised fare before departure; the difference is credited to Rapid Rewards points via self-service.
